io.milvus.orm.iterator

Class IteratorCache

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.orm.iterator.IteratorCache

  • public class IteratorCache
extends Object
    Thread-safe cache of query results used by the query and search iterators to paginate data.

    Results are stored under an integer cache ID and can be appended, drained and released incrementally. The cache supports an internal read offset so that already consumed records are not returned again. All operations are synchronized, making the cache safe to be shared across threads.

    • Method Detail

      • cache

        public int cache(int cacheId,
                 List<QueryResultsWrapper.RowRecord> result)
        Caches the given result rows under the specified cache ID and returns the effective ID.

        If cacheId equals Constant.NO_CACHE_ID, a new ID is allocated automatically.

        Parameters:
        cacheId - the cache ID to store under, or NO_CACHE_ID to allocate a new one
        result - the result rows to cache
        Returns:
        the cache ID under which the rows were stored
        Throws:
        ParamException - if result is null

      • fetchCache

        public List<QueryResultsWrapper.RowRecord> fetchCache(int cacheId)
        Returns a snapshot of the unconsumed rows cached under the given cache ID.

        The snapshot is a copy of the cached rows, so consuming the returned list does not change the cached state.

        Parameters:
        cacheId - the cache ID to fetch
        Returns:
        a copy of the cached rows, or null if the cache ID is not present

      • size

        public int size(int cacheId)
        Returns the number of unconsumed rows cached under the given cache ID.
        Parameters:
        cacheId - the cache ID to check
        Returns:
        the number of cached rows, or 0 if the cache ID is not present

      • append

        public int append(int cacheId,
                  List<QueryResultsWrapper.RowRecord> result)
        Appends the given result rows to the cache entry under the given cache ID.
        Parameters:
        cacheId - the cache ID to append to
        result - the result rows to append
        Returns:
        the total number of unconsumed rows after appending
        Throws:
        ParamException - if result is null or cacheId is invalid

      • drain

        public List<QueryResultsWrapper.RowRecord> drain(int cacheId,
                                                 int count)
        Drains up to the given number of rows from the cache, marking them as consumed.

        Once all rows of a cache entry are drained, the entry is removed from the cache.

        Parameters:
        cacheId - the cache ID to drain from
        count - the number of rows to drain
        Returns:
        the drained rows
        Throws:
        ParamException - if count is negative, the cache ID is not present, or count exceeds the number of cached rows

      • releaseCache

        public void releaseCache(int cacheId)
        Removes the cache entry with the given cache ID, releasing the cached rows.
        Parameters:
        cacheId - the cache ID to release
